selected_evidence.requirement: Containerized web app running as unprivileged appsvc on port 8080
selected_evidence.summary: podman run as appsvc (uid 1001) publishing 8080:80, curl to 8080 returns 200, podman inspect shows Ports=8080 and RestartPolicy=always

selected_evidence.requirement: Rootless podman functional for appsvc (unprivileged account)
selected_evidence.summary: podman info succeeds as appsvc; subuid/subgid ranges configured for rootless operation

selected_evidence.requirement: App starts at boot via OpenRC (not login-session dependent)
selected_evidence.summary: Custom /etc/init.d/appsvc-webapp OpenRC script added to default runlevel; starts container via su as appsvc; who/w show no login session for appsvc while container processes run

selected_evidence.requirement: No active login session for appsvc while service runs
selected_evidence.summary: who command returns empty both immediately after manual start and after full reboot recovery, confirming appsvc has no interactive session

selected_evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline captured before node1 restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id, OpenRC service status (started), podman ps (webapp Up), and curl 200 immediately before each of the three reboot attempts
Backgrounded `reboot` commands returned 'reboot issued' immediately, then subsequent exec calls failed with connection reset/timeout confirming the node went down after acknowledgement

selected_evidence.requirement: Boot identity changed after restart (proof of actual reboot, per node)
selected_evidence.summary: boot_id changed each time: 27ee249d... -> 1e9d3e23... -> 4cd128cc... -> c2d49a16..., each paired with 'up 0 min' uptime confirming fresh boot

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required service, container, and app (final, working state)
selected_evidence.summary: After the final reboot: rc-service appsvc-webapp status = started, podman ps shows webapp Up 10 seconds automatically (no manual intervention), curl to NODE_IP:8080 returns 200 with page content, who shows no login session

selected_evidence.requirement: Diagnosis and fix of rootless-podman post-reboot failure (supporting evidence for why recovery required a script fix)
selected_evidence.summary: First two reboots showed the service failed to start (stale /tmp/storage-run-1001 boot-id mismatch); init script updated to clean that directory in start(), verified working via manual stop/start cycle before final reboot proved it
